goal: Add a scoped Playwright spec (e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts) covering the QMS-TR page against mock-server: load with Brasil card, run to completion with step progress + download, a failed-run case with error message/logs/retry, and a history view listing a previous run.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: New e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts exists and covers: load /qms-tr and see the Brasil card.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: grep test names in e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts; run the spec

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Spec fills ano_base, clicks Ejecutar/Confirmar, and asserts step progress advances to completed (Completado badge).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: rtk proxy npx playwright test e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts -g completa

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Spec clicks the download button and asserts a download event fires with the expected filename pattern.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: rtk proxy npx playwright test e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts -g completa

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Spec seeds a failed run (via mock force_outcome=fail) and asserts the error message, a way to view logs (detail modal), and a Reintentar/retry button are all visible.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: rtk proxy npx playwright test e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts -g error

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Spec opens the history view (click card) and asserts at least one previous run is listed.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: rtk proxy npx playwright test e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts -g historial

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `rtk proxy npx playwright test e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts` passes in full, green, against mock-server; no other spec file is modified or run.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: rtk proxy npx playwright test e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Root-cause fix: mock-server/routes/qms_tr.js run-level error field renamed from `error` to `error_message` to match the frontend contract (QmsTrRun.error_message, used by every other module's run store) so AC4's error text actually renders — without this the UI never shows the error message and ac4 cannot pass.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: grep -n error_message mock-server/routes/qms_tr.js; npx vitest run (or mock-server test runner) mock-server/__tests__/qms_tr.test.js

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Root-cause fix: mock-server/routes/test.js POST /test/reset now calls resetQmsTrJobs() (was never wired in, unlike every other run store) so QMS-TR job state doesn't leak across tests/mock-server lifetime — without this the history spec (ac5) is flaky/fails once more than one qms_tr run has ever been created against the running mock.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: grep -n resetQmsTrJobs mock-server/routes/test.js; run e2e/qms-tr.spec.ts 3x in a row against the same mock process, all green

tasks.desc: Fix mock-server/routes/qms_tr.js: rename job-level `error` field to `error_message` (keep step-level `.error`); update qms_tr.test.js assertion accordingly
Run full VERIFY_CMD (vitest+lint+tsc) + the new spec in isolation, confirm green
Root-cause fix: wire resetQmsTrJobs() into POST /test/reset (mock-server/routes/test.js) so QMS-TR state doesn't leak across tests/full mock-server lifetime
